description.value: The Office Pub & Grill is a pub and grill located in Burns Lake in BC's Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior region. OSM tags indicate a wide-ranging menu spanning American, burger, chicken, diner, fish and chips, German, and Italian cuisine, suggesting it caters to a broad appetite. Burns Lake sits along Highway 16 (the Yellowhead), making it a natural stop for touring cyclists crossing the interior of British Columbia.
